purpose: A band that points readers to further reading on solution pages: an overline, a headline and a short lead with an optional button sit beside a two-column frame grid of linked resource cards, each a title and one sentence. A card whose link leaves the site opens in a new tab; past four cards the grid scrolls inside a fading scroll area so the band keeps its height. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'resource-grid', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `media-split`, `card-grid`, `topic`, `scroll-area` and `button`.
useWhen: To close a solution page with documentation, articles and stories that go deeper into it.
avoidWhen: For related articles with covers → use `article-cards`.
For linked use cases with media → use `use-case-links`.
related: media-split` — the copy-beside-media band that owns the heading and the named region.
topic` — the linked title-and-sentence cell each card is rendered with.
bestPractices: Keep four cards for a full grid; more than four scroll.
Give a card a full `http` link only when it leaves the site, so only those open in a new tab.
